basic_info.description: Luxurious, spacious living in this contemporary one bedroom, one bathroom condominium located across from Buena Vista Park. The home features beautiful walnut-stained wood floors, oversized windows with views of the restored Chapel, Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower, plus recessed lighting and designer finishes. The living/dining main room has soaring ceilings, walnut finished wood floors and an abundance of natural light through the large windows. There is a modern chef's kitchen with stainless appliances including refrigerator, electric range, microwave and dishwasher. The spacious bedroom has two closets with custom fittings and verdant garden outlooks. The designer bathroom has been expanded and includes Waterworks fixtures and Heath tile plus storage and an in-unit washer and dryer. One car parking and additional storage. Park Hill Condominiums feature beautifully manicured gardens, front desk concierge and an ideal location close to all the shopping and amenities of Cole Valley, the Divisadero Corridor and the Castro, MUNI and public transit.
